notes.title: Scheduled release date of “Living in Spring”
notes.notes:
Hello.
I am Takashi YUKIHARA, a director of “Living in Spring”.

Thank you for your interest in the game.
I announced that the release date is 02/29/2024 in the store page.
But there is no time information (cannot display it), so I announce the release time.

Release Date and Time: [b]02/29/2024 18:00 (JST)[/b]

It's also 02/29/2024 1:00 in PST.
Two DLC (digital wallpapers and soundtrack) will also be released on the same.
I wish you wait the day, quietly and in relax.


Takashi YUKIHARA
